marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Working in a Large Resort : A Case Study : Club Med on Lindeman Island

Large resorts are very popular forms of tourism. Wheather it be to relax on a beach, ski thee snowfields or merely take a break from everyday life, resorts encompass a wide range of activities and services including accommodation, entertainment, melas and drink service. Each eelement of a resort is reliant upon the success of another element therefore effective organisational management is crucial to ensuring the resort can create an experience the guest is seeking
